content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Minimum educational qualification Intermediate or equivalent; Only women candidates are eligible; Must be a permanent resident of the ward / gram sabha of the vacant post Age limit: 18 to 35 years (as on 1 July 2026) Other conditions: Only women candidates are eligible Must be a permanent resident of the ward / gram sabha of the vacant post; residents of other gram sabhas, wards, districts or states are not accepted Two women of the same family will not be appointed as Anganwadi Worker and Helper at the same Anganwadi centre For urban vacancies the Tehsil's online residence certificate should show the ward number and ward name Date of birth in the High School marksheet and certificate alone is accepted for age

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for District Programme Officer (ICDS), Ghazipur Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Men Residents of another gram sabha, ward, district or state than that of the vacancy

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Honorarium (manday) based post; the amount is not printed in the notice. Post is fully temporary and honorarium-based UP State Employees Service Rules do not apply Service can be ended at any time as per government directions

content_sections.heading: How Will District Programme Officer (ICDS), Ghazipur Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Selection by order of preference set in the Government Order (widow, divorced/abandoned woman, other women of BPL families, then APL families) Merit list on qualifications (minimum Intermediate, maximum postgraduate) when more than one eligible candidate is in the same category No written examination or interview Preference: BPL widow, then BPL legally divorced or abandoned woman, then other women of BPL families of the same gram sabha / ward If none, the same order for APL families If none in the gram sabha, category-wise selection from the concerned Nyay Panchayat Merit on minimum Intermediate and maximum postgraduate qualification when several eligible candidates are in one category

content_sections.heading: District Programme Officer (ICDS), Ghazipur Exam Pattern 2026
Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Self-attested copies of documents mentioned in the online form For widows: death certificate issued by Gram Panchayat Officer / Nagar Nikay and certified copy of the Parivar Register For divorced / abandoned women: legal order issued by the Hon'ble Court Income certificate issued by the competent level, verifiable online Residence, income and caste certificates issued online by the Tehsil with digital signature

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for District Programme Officer (ICDS), Ghazipur Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Apply online only on http://upanganwadibharti.in within the set period. Fill the application on the format available on the departmental website carefully and correctly. Upload clean and legible self-attested copies of documents on the portal and mention them in the online form. Submit by midnight 12:00 on 09-12-2026; offline or postal applications and documents are not accepted.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for District Programme Officer (ICDS), Ghazipur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 9 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in District Programme Officer (ICDS), Ghazipur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 174 vacancies for Anganwadi Worker.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for District Programme Officer (ICDS), Ghazipur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 9 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18 to 35 years (as on 1 July 2026).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Honorarium-based post; amount not printed in the notice.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Minimum Intermediate or equivalent; women only; permanent resident of the ward / gram sabha of the vacancy.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Only women candidates are eligible. Must be a permanent resident of the ward / gram sabha of the vacant post; residents of other gram sabhas, wards, districts or states are not accepted. Two women of the same family will not be appointed as Anganwadi Worker and Helper at the same Anganwadi centre. For urban vacancies the Tehsil's online residence certificate should show the ward number and ward name.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Men. Residents of another gram sabha, ward, district or state than that of the vacancy.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Selection by order of preference set in the Government Order (widow, divorced/abandoned woman, other women of BPL families, then APL families). Merit list on qualifications (minimum Intermediate, maximum postgraduate) when more than one eligible candidate is in the same category. No written examination or interview. Preference: BPL widow, then BPL legally divorced or abandoned woman, then other women of BPL families of the same gram sabha / ward.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Post is fully temporary and honorarium-based. UP State Employees Service Rules do not apply. Service can be ended at any time as per government directions.
